thread:
maya: Quick sync — we need a small API/console proposal for SLO-driven routing by customer tier+region. Goal: let platform teams declare latency/availability SLOs per tier and an ordered fallback of model variants/regions, plus circuit-breaker thresholds tied to observed latency/error telemetry.
ashok: high-level, agree. Do we want the policy stored as a single JSON blob per tenant or a set of rules in the routing service?
maya: preference for declarative policies per customer in control-plane. router pulls compiled policy and calculates live decisions. Keep policy small: matchers + targets + cbs.
samira: telemetry required: p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rates (5xx/timeout), capacity headroom, queue length. Also need histograms for token-level latency to detect slow token loops.
joel: console UX: users should be able to preview fallback chain with simulated traffic and see expected latency/cost delta. Also allow canary rollout of new policy.
ashok: API sketch:
```json
{
 "tier": "gold",
 "region": "eu-west-1",
 "slo": {"latency_ms": 200, "availability_pct": 99.9},
 "fallbacks": [
  {"model": "redwood-3-small-q8", "max_latency_ms": 400, "priority": 10},
  {"region": "us-west-2", "model": "redwood-3-small-q4", "priority": 20}
 ],
 "circuit_breaker": {"error_rate_pct": 2.0, "window_s": 60, "min_calls": 50}
}
```
maya: two debates: 1) should CB be tenant-global or route-specific? 2) metric used: error_rate vs latency_exceed_pct?
samira: prefer route-specific CB with both error_rate and latency_exceed_pct. latency_exceed_pct = pct of requests > slo.latency_ms in window.
ashok: implementation detail: router should evaluate CB before routing to variant so we can short-circuit and go to fallback. Also allow soft-fallback: prefer fallback but still try primary if capacity permits (probabilistic fallback).
joel: console controls: slider for CB sensitivity, toggle for soft vs hard fallback, preview heatmap by region. Need telemetry wiring: per-route per-variant time series, and alerting for regressions.
maya: ops questions: how to avoid oscillation if CB trips and then recovers quickly? propose cooldown + hysteresis: trip -> open for N s; half-open probes at p% traffic; close if success rate > threshold.
samira: add decay-weighted smoothing to avoid noisy spikes. Also need tagging so we can rollbacks by policy version.
ashok: backlog tasks: (1) define compact policy schema (2) console mockups for preview + canary (3) router proto change to accept compiled policy + CB state (4) telemetry contract + histogram buckets.
joel: i'll sketch console flows by EOD. @deploy-bot please run canary util when ready.
deploy-bot: canary util build passed on main, tag v0.7.3 — deployed to staging :rocket: 
maya: thanks — let's keep the design thread here. I'll open a RFC doc with API examples and a short simulator harness plan.
joel: +1
samira: +1
ashok: +1 :thumbsup:
